beats.text: Among 208 entities, 61 have fewer than 50 percent of people in cities.
Yellow areas show entities at or above 50 percent urban, while dark blue areas are mostly rural.
Urban population refers to people living in urban areas as defined by national statistical offices.
Among these entities, Kuwait is 100 percent urban, while Papua N. Guinea is 16 percent.
Comparing urban shares, Japan is 92 percent, China is 66 percent, and India is 36 percent.
